doc: Reducing consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages to reduce the risk of unhealthy weight gain in adults

entries.claim: WHO推荐减少游离糖摄入，并将游离糖摄入量控制在总能量摄入的10%以下。
entries.source_doc: Reducing consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages to reduce the risk of unhealthy weight gain in adults

entries.claim: WHO建议进一步将游离糖摄入量降至总能量摄入的5%以下。
entries.source_doc: Reducing consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages to reduce the risk of unhealthy weight gain in adults

entries.claim: 减少含糖饮料的消费可降低成人不健康体重增加的风险。
entries.source_doc: Reducing consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages to reduce the risk of unhealthy weight gain in adults
